projectDescription: A full-stack mess and tiffin management platform for owners to manage subscriptions, meals, payments, and delivery, and for customers to order food, track bills, and leave reviews.
keyFeatures: Multi-mess tenancy — each owner manages an independent mess with scoped menus, plans, customers, and payments
Subscription management — weekly, monthly, trial, and custom-duration plans with owner approval workflow
Single-meal (à la carte) ordering — customers can order one published meal without a subscription
Meal skip and pause — customers skip individual meals or pause a date range before the cutoff time
Guest meal booking — customers add guests to a meal and the bill updates automatically
Owner-confirmed payment workflow — customers submit payment screenshots; owner confirms receipts and updates balances
Delivery tracking — owners mark meals as preparing, out for delivery, or delivered; customers see live status
AI Kitchen Advisor — analyzes customer reviews with Gemini to surface actionable kitchen improvements
AI menu photo generation — Cloudflare Workers AI generates food photos automatically from the menu text
In-app owner/customer chat — real-time floating chat widget with unread badges and idempotent retries
English/Hindi localization — i18next UI translations plus Google Translate for saved descriptions
Join QR code — owners share a reusable QR; customers self-register and wait for approval
Public mess page — no-login landing page showing menus, plans, timings, and public reviews
Downloadable receipts — customers view confirmed payment receipts inside the Bills section
OTP signup verification — optional Twilio SMS or console-mode OTP for phone verification
